fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Evilities (796 x 96, pool layout: 10 strptr fields into the string pool after the records). Record: id, names, slot cost, descriptions (%d = value1/value2), kind (unique/normal), effect group, values, source, display category, Mana cost, owner char/class, class learn order, version group. A class owns 6 evilities (owner = class id, class_order 1..6, 6 = unique); characters own theirs via owner too; the innate evility of a char.dat row is at char.dat +0xB8.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: evility id (key). 10-410 character evilities (grouped per character, e.g. 10-16 Killia), 1010-1242 generic human classes (6 per class: x0 = class unique), 2010-2215 monster classes, 3000-3306 innocent-granted evilities (HABIT.dat evility), 4000-4603 generic shop evilities, 5000-5026 system/enemy-only, 6001-6306 DLC characters. Referenced by char.dat (+0xB8 innate evility), HABIT.dat, ItemGetSkillDataBase.dat

fields.desc: uniqueness

fields.name: effect_group
fields.desc: internal effect family 0..44 (9 plain stat % boosts, 11 conditional stat boosts, 2 damage-dealt, 3 damage-taken, 15 EXP/mana/rewards, 17 ally auras, 18 enemy auras, 29 immunities, 24 Magichange/explosion, 44 = all innocent/item evilities 3000-3306 and 6125). Grouping only; the actual handler seems keyed by id

fields.name: value1
fields.desc: first %d of the description (Muscle Increase 10 = +10% ATK, Status Guard 90)

fields.name: value2
fields.desc: second %d of the description (Violence 50% EXP, Magic Bundle 50% more SP)

fields.name: source

enum.1: generic special (team attack / Magichange / Chara World)

fields.desc: where the evility comes from

fields.name: category
fields.desc: display category (evility list filter/icon)

fields.name: subcategory
fields.desc: secondary grouping 0..18 (1 INT/ATK growth & counters, 2 two-stat, 3 HIT growth, 4 SPD, 5 single-stat %, 6 HP recovery, 7 SP/skill power, 8 critical, 11 panels moved, 12 ailments, 15 EXP/steal...). Sort/filter aid, meaning partly guessed

fields.name: mana_cost
fields.desc: Mana cost to learn (100/250/1000/5000/30000 for character evilities, 10000 for a class unique, 0 = cannot be learned)

fields.name: shop_rank
fields.desc: 0..4 (one 9) on generic shop evilities 4000-4324; probably shop rank / unlock tier (elemental bodies 2, managements 3, blessings 4)

fields.name: owner
fields.desc: character/class that owns or teaches it (char.dat id at +0xD0; Killia 10, Warrior family 1010); 0 = generic

fields.name: class_order
fields.desc: generic classes: learn order 1..5, 6 = the class unique (x0) evility; 0 otherwise

fields.name: version_group
fields.desc: 100 base game; 110-150 DLC content groups (same codes as magic.dat version_group); 0 on 2 unused rows
